archive_frequency: Daily at 04:00 UTC with up to five-minute jitter. The job requires the declared archive mount, budget and 400 GiB reserve, waits for 60 continuous seconds below 2% full I/O PSI in active MIDAS service cgroups (including the protected recorder), and rechecks before every segment and replay segment. Host-wide PSI is advisory because unrelated services can dominate it. Missing protected-service telemetry fails closed. Each safe-window wait fails closed after three hours; the complete operation has a separate six-hour bound. No hard I/O bandwidth controller is available. Keep the timer disabled until the initial full copy/replay manifest and its incremental baseline are verified.
derivative_pruning: Only deploy/reality-research.json scheduled completed example caches and unpublished builder scratch are disposable. Keep immutable manifests/code/source references and visible pruning receipts. Raw roots, accepted Gate B/C/D artifacts and protected Prometheus evidence are excluded.
offloading: Verified local archive on the allocated /dev/sda4 staging filesystem; this is a second copy, not off-host redundancy. Never delete originals automatically.
rollover: A new raw root requires an intentional collector stop, finalized verified archive, retained old-root manifest, and reviewed disk commitments. Keep the original root recoverable; new root identity/ordinals must remain distinct. No automatic rollover is configured.
on_exhaustion: Fail closed, publish FAILED status if disk permits, retain complete checksummed observations, require operator capacity action. Do not drop frames or erase observations to maintain an apparently healthy state.
headroom_basis: Separate commitments: raw budget up to 112 GiB on NVMe with a 20 GiB free reserve; verified archive budget up to 112 GiB on /dev/sda4 with a 400 GiB reserve. At the 2026-10-21 12:20 CEST capacity receipt, raw use was 4,995,518,844 B and NVMe free space was 175,444,942,848 B. The two demo API databases occupied about 8.98 GB at 12:22; a paired 2 h 20 min sample confirmed approximately 670 MB/day and 640 MB/day growth. The conservative 30-day high-water allowance remains 31.4 GB (above the newer 29.6 GB estimate). Filling the staged raw budget plus that database high-water allowance, the 20 GiB reserve, and a 4 GiB Veritas budget leaves about 3.0 GB further NVMe headroom. Recovery/archive temporary space is on the separate HDD. No historical files were removed.
research_priority: Collector: 896 MiB MemoryHigh, 1 GiB MemoryMax, zero swap, 25% of one CPU. Capacity monitor: 128 MiB, 10% CPU. Archive: 640 MiB MemoryHigh, 768 MiB MemoryMax, zero swap, up to one CPU, Nice 15 and idle I/O scheduling class. User cgroups do not expose io.max; idle I/O class is not a hard throughput guarantee.
limits: At the 12:20 CEST capacity receipt, the staged 112 GiB budget leaves 115,263,565,444 B. Byte-budget-only runway is about 118.5 days at the conservative 973,161,695 B/day floor, but the 120-day age stop has 112.9 days remaining because the oldest record is already about 7.1 days old; the monitor's configured effective runway is 112.9 days. The latest short sample was lower (about 749 MB/day), but the conservative floor governs. The earlier 11:50 sample was 1.021 GB/day (about 112.9 byte-budget days), and the prior measured high of 1.25 GB/day gives about 92.2 byte-budget days. The currently loaded 24 GiB / 90-day contract remains about 21.35 days at the conservative floor until an explicitly approved restart.

For a 90-day initial expansion envelope, cap measured total raw growth at 1.2x the conservative floor (about 1.168 GB/day) until longer production measurements support revision. That uses about 105.1 GB of the remaining 115.3 GB raw budget. After the conservative 31.4 GB database high-water allowance, 4 GiB Veritas budget, and 20 GiB NVMe reserve, about 13.2 GB additional headroom remains. At full use of the 112 GiB raw budget, the same shared-service commitments leave about 3.0 GB above the reserve; do not allocate another raw budget without reducing shared growth or adding storage. A 2x sustained raw workload is not supported for 90 days.
Local replication is not off-host redundancy.
The protected recorder still enforces its loaded 24 GiB budget and 90-day retention. The 112 GiB / 120-day candidate configuration is prepared but pending the approved transition.
No raw pruning, automatic rollover, or new collectors are configured. Sustained operation beyond the effective budget or retention horizon requires an intentional reviewed root rollover.
Capacity monitoring samples every 30 minutes, warns at 30 days, marks critical at 14 days, and requires capacity action by 7 days without pruning raw data.

The user service cgroup has no I/O controller, so archival throughput cannot be capped with io.max. The archive gates on active MIDAS service I/O-full PSI at 2% avg10/avg60, waits for a 60-second quiet window, and rechecks between copy/replay segments. Host-wide PSI is advisory; service attribution found netdata.service contributing 1.47% avg10 while the recorder cgroup was at 0.20% avg10, and sampled NVMe/HDD utilization was below 25%. Each admission wait has a three-hour limit and the full operation has a separate six-hour maximum. The first attempt reached 11.82% host avg10 and was safely interrupted before a manifest was published. Keep the timer disabled until the bounded initial archive and incremental baseline are validated.
forecast_floor_basis: Historical conservative raw growth measurement; keep until at least 90 days of current production measurements support revision.

shared_service_storage.projection_basis: Read-only SQLite file-size samples from 10:02 to 12:22 CEST plus indexed min/max record timestamps. The current short-sample projection is about 29.6 GB additional through each database 30-day high-water mark; retain the prior 31.4 GB allowance as the conservative planning value and remeasure over the 90-day horizon.
